<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The hooks file assumes a Claude Code environment by referencing `CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH` and `CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME`. This is a platform-specific assumption that may cause compatibility issues.

Codex expects stdin JSON with `tool_name` and `tool_input`, yet matchers like Edit and Write map to `apply_patch` while MultiEdit may be Claude-specific. The file duplicates commands heavily: 17 PostToolUse groups cover only 5 unique prefixes, with repeated entries for git add, git commit, and quality enforcer. Auto-committing on every edit violates AGENTS.md rules against unrequested commits and risks race conditions with concurrent agents. Performance concerns are also flagged.

Prettier runs on every edit, causing severe cold-start delays. A wildcard matcher triggers notifications on every tool call, spamming osascript. The quality enforcer performs triple checks with dozens of greps. SessionStart loads AGENTS.md twice. Omitted timeouts default to 600 seconds. The quality enforcer exits with code 2 on PostToolUse, which cannot be undone, making the block late and awkward. Its advice is outdated, flagging false positives on Server Components with interactive patterns. The inline bash is a massive unmaintainable one-liner.

PreCompact and Stop contain hardcoded absolute paths. The Stop hook mutates DAILY_WORK_PLAN.md, risking races with concurrent agents and duplicating headers. Running the formatter after commit leaves unformatted changes committed. The file also lacks a $schema and description.

A single Edit on a .tsx file triggers roughly three git adds, four commits, three quality checks, two prettier runs, and one notification. The hook sequence repeats the same file multiple times in rapid succession. This confirms the worst-case performance impact.
</details></think>

**Verdict: do not ship as-is.** `.codex/hooks.json` looks like a Claude Code paste-collision — duplicated PostToolUse handlers, auto-commit on every edit, and `CLAUDE_*` env vars that don’t match Codex’s stdin contract.

Full breakdown: [codex-hooks-json-review](canvases/codex-hooks-json-review.canvas.tsx)

### Critical

| Issue | Detail |
|---|---|
| Auto-commit cascade | Edit/Write hooks `git add` + `git commit` (copied ~4×). Conflicts with AGENTS.md (“never commit unless asked”) and multi-agent safety |
| ~70% duplication | 17 PostToolUse groups → 5 unique command prefixes; same add/commit/quality blocks repeated |
